definitions.explanation: The organ of smell and breathing on the face.

examples.english: To have a high nose; to be proud.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鼻水|はなみず}→鼻水：04430_hanamizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。

examples.english: Dogs have a good sense of smell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鼻|はな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{近|ちか}づけて→近づける：02074_chikazukeru⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かいだ→嗅ぐ：02036_kagu⟧。
examples.english: I brought my nose close to the flower and smelled it.

notes:
{鼻|はな} refers to the nose — both the physical organ and its metaphorical use in expressions about pride and perception.

WATCH OUT:
{鼻|はな} (nose) and ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower) share the same reading. They are distinguished by pitch accent in standard Japanese.

COMMON PHYSICAL EXPRESSIONS:
- {鼻|はな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かむ→噛む：01205_kamu⟧: to blow one's nose
- ⟦{鼻水|はなみず}→鼻水：04430_hanamizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to have a runny nose
- {鼻|はな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: to have a stuffy nose
- {鼻|はな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧: to have a good sense of smell

FIGURATIVE EXPRESSIONS:
- {鼻|はな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to be proud (literally 'high nose')
- {鼻|はな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}る→折る：01263_oru⟧: to humble someone, to take someone down a peg
- {鼻|はな}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to sneer at, to laugh scornfully
- {鼻|はな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to get on one's nerves, to be annoying
